description: Create a new email address (alias) on one of the workspace's own domains (e.g. support@yourdomain.com) and route its inbound mail to a real inbox. Inbound forwarding starts working once the address exists; sending from it needs the domain to be verified. Goes through the same plan limits and forwarding rules as the dashboard, so it can fail with a limit or upgrade message. One address per call. Call it once per domain to add the same local part across several. Rejects an address that already exists.

domain.description: A domain in this workspace, e.g. yourdomain.com

forward_to.description: Inbox to forward to. Defaults to the account's own email; anything else is a paid-plan feature.

name: create_alias
